name: OmaQuota
author: basar-yilmaz
description: Limits, reset times and one-click account switching for Claude Code, Codex and Grok, plus limits for Cursor, Kimi, z.ai and every other Omarchy usage collector. Two styles: Cards and Compact.

barWidget.description: Per agent: logo and what's left in the bar, limits and resets on hover, one-click account switching with settings that follow the account, usage details and files in a drawer. Cards or Compact.

schema.label: Style
schema.description: Cards: a framed tile per agent with large figures. Compact: one thin line per limit. Right-click the bar icon to swap.

schema.label: Panel size
schema.description: Scales the panel's text and spacing. The bar itself keeps Omarchy's sizes.

schema.label: Numbers show
schema.description: Show what's left of each limit, how much is used, or both (left as the main number, used beside it). The bar shows what's left in Both.

schema.label: Bar logos
schema.description: Brand colours, or tinted to match the bar text.

schema.label: Reset time in the bar
schema.description: Adds a short countdown, such as 46% · 2d, next to each agent in the bar.

schema.label: Agents in the bar
schema.description: Set from each agent's gear in the panel. Format: agent:limit, for example claude:Week,codex:5h. The bar then shows each one's logo and what's left of that limit.

schema.label: Agents showing every account in the bar
schema.description: Set from an agent's Settings tab (In the bar → Accounts). Comma-separated agent ids, for example claude. Those agents show each account's share of the chosen limit, tagged by its first letters.

schema.label: Extra providers
schema.description: Comma-separated Omarchy usage collectors shown next to Claude Code, Codex and Grok, for example cursor,kimi,zai. Any name from `ls $OMARCHY_PATH/bin/omarchy-agent-usage-*` works.

schema.label: Warn at (%)
schema.description: One desktop notification per limit window when it reaches this. Agents with two or more accounts use Omarchy's own threshold and auto-switch instead.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often limits are fetched in the background. Short intervals can hit Anthropic's rate limit.

schema.label: Show what's left of the tightest limit next to the icon
schema.description: Used while no agent is picked for the bar.

schema.label: Demo data file
schema.description: For screenshots: show the invented accounts in a JSON file (see demo/accounts.json) instead of your own. Switching and settings writes are off while it is set.
